{{Quote|I'm from Imperial Intelligence's Experimental Weapons Division. Supposed to trick hapless fools into testing a new weapon.|Geris Paelid|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Geris Paelid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As a member of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Experimental Weapons Division]] he was dispatched to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with a mission to test an experimental weapon on unsuspecting locals. He was however unsuccessful in tricking anyone and was eventually forced to ask a fellow Imperial for help with combat testing the prototype.<ref name="TOR" />
